g.text: One isolated solver run per query; timeout cells are censored, not completed solves.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #53626d

g.text: Queries come from the finalized data-prefix helper benchmark. cvc5 uses the trusted Veil options and a 10-second limit.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #53626d

g.text: SAT/UNSAT refer to the selected bounded trace assertions, not protocol safety in general. These samples do not establish a solver speedup.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #53626d

g.text: A missing query records preprocessing failure; it is distinct from a solver timeout. Exact results and assertions are retained in the solver CSV.
